SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers
FROM sales.Customers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers
FROM sales.Customers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DiscontinuedProducts
FROM catalog.Products
WHERE IsDiscontinued = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DiscontinuedProducts
FROM catalog.Products
WHERE IsDiscontinued = 1

SELECT c.Country, COUNT(*) AS Customers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
GROUP BY c.Country
ORDER BY Customers DESC

SELECT c.Country, COUNT(*) AS Customers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
GROUP BY c.Country
ORDER BY Customers DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= '2023-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= '2023-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-01-01'

SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(2025, MONTH(o.OrderDate), 1) AS Month, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS Orders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY MONTH(o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY Month

SELECT DATEPART(year, o.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, DATEPART(month, o.OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(*) AS Orders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY DATEPART(year, o.OrderDate), DATEPART(month, o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY OrderYear, OrderMonth

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, -1, GETDATE())
  AND OrderDate < GETDATE()

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)
  AND OrderDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers
FROM sales.Customers
WHERE YEAR(createdAt) = 2025

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers
FROM sales.Customers
WHERE CreatedAt >= '2025-01-01' AND CreatedAt < '2026-01-01'

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS TotalRevenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS TotalRevenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
  YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS Year,
  CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY Year ASC

SELECT 
  YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS Year,
  CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY Year ASC

SELECT TOP (10) c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT TOP (10) c.CustomerId, COALESCE(c.CompanyName, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName)) AS CustomerName, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT c.Segment, AVG(l.LineTotal) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT c.Segment, AVG(t.OrderRevenue) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN (
  SELECT o.OrderId, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS OrderRevenue
  FROM sales.Orders o
  JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
  WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  GROUP BY o.OrderId
) AS t ON t.OrderId = o.OrderId
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT TOP (5) p.Sku, p.Name, SUM(l.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = l.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.Sku, p.Name
ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC

SELECT TOP (5) p.Sku, p.Name, SUM(l.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = l.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.Sku, p.Name
ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC

SELECT TOP (1) ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrderCount
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed ON ed.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName
ORDER BY OrderCount DESC

SELECT TOP (1) ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrdersHandled
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed ON ed.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName
ORDER BY OrdersHandled DESC

SELECT TOP (1) s.SupplierId, s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) AS ProductCount
FROM catalog.Suppliers AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.SupplierId = s.SupplierId
GROUP BY s.SupplierId, s.Name
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

SELECT TOP (1) s.SupplierId, s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) AS ProductCount
FROM catalog.Suppliers AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.SupplierId = s.SupplierId
GROUP BY s.SupplierId, s.Name
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

SELECT o.ShipCountry, COUNT(*) AS CancelledOrders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.Status = 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY o.ShipCountry

SELECT o.ShipCountry, COUNT(*) AS CancelledOrders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.Status = 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY o.ShipCountry

SELECT d.Name AS Department, COUNT(ed.EmployeeId) AS Employees
FROM hr.Departments AS d
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed ON ed.DepartmentId = d.DepartmentId
WHERE ed.TerminationDate IS NULL
GROUP BY d.Name

SELECT d.Name AS Department, COUNT(ed.EmployeeId) AS EmployeeCount
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN hr.Departments AS d ON d.DepartmentId = ed.DepartmentId
WHERE ed.TerminationDate IS NULL
GROUP BY d.Name
ORDER BY EmployeeCount DESC

SELECT ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, ed.Email
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS m ON ed.ManagerId = m.EmployeeId
WHERE m.JobTitle = 'VP of Sales'

SELECT ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, ed.Email
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS m ON ed.ManagerId = m.EmployeeId
WHERE m.JobTitle = 'VP of Sales'

SELECT c.Name AS Category, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM catalog.Categories AS c
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.CategoryId = c.CategoryId
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = l.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT tc.Name AS Category, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
JOIN catalog.Categories AS c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId
JOIN catalog.Categories AS tc ON tc.CategoryId = COALESCE(c.ParentCategoryId, c.CategoryId)
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY tc.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, COUNT(s.ProductId) AS ProductsBelowReorder
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
WHERE s.QuantityOnHand < s.ReorderLevel
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, COUNT(s.ProductId) AS ProductsBelowReorderLevel
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
WHERE s.QuantityOnHand < s.ReorderLevel
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.UnitCost) AS TotalStockValue
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.UnitCost) AS StockValueAtCost
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand) AS UnitsOnHand
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand) AS UnitsInStock
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1

SELECT SUM(p.Amount) AS TotalRefunds
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 1
  AND p.PaidAt >= '2025-01-01' AND p.PaidAt < '2026-01-01'

SELECT SUM(p.Amount) AS TotalRefunded
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 1
  AND p.PaidAt >= '2025-01-01' AND p.PaidAt < '2026-01-01'

SELECT p.Method, COUNT(*) AS PaymentCount
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 0
GROUP BY p.Method

SELECT p.Method, COUNT(*) AS PaymentCount
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 0
GROUP BY p.Method

SELECT COUNT(o.OrderId) AS DeliveredOrdersWithoutPayment
FROM sales.Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN sales.Payments AS p ON p.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered' AND p.OrderId IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(o.OrderId) AS UnpaidDeliveredOrders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN sales.Payments AS p ON p.OrderId = o.OrderId AND p.IsRefund = 0
WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered' AND p.OrderId IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomersWithNoOrders
FROM sales.Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE o.OrderId IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomersWithNoOrders
FROM sales.Customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM sales.Orders AS o
  WHERE o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
)

SELECT c.Segment, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) * 100 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS CancelledPercentage
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT c.Segment, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS CancelledPercentage
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.Segment
